# zlib 1.3.2 inflate subset

Source: https://zlib.net/zlib-1.3.2.tar.gz (2026-02-17).
SHA-256: bb329a0a2cd0274d05519d61c667c062e06990d72e125ee2dfa8de64f0119d16.

Only the raw inflate and checksum dependencies are vendored. Build with
Z_SOLO and NO_GZIP; compression and gzip file APIs are not included.
Altered files are marked and retain their upstream notices. Turbo C 2.0
adaptations replace unsupported far typedefs, fix two far pointer declarations,
remove unsupported #warning and keep CRC arrays near. The immutable fixed Huffman tables are relocated
outside DGROUP via FIXED.ASM (generated by tools/zlib_tables.py). See docs/zip-support.md.

The zlib license is in zlib.h and LICENSE; it permits this redistribution.
